anomalies.observed: R60 (130R) has pin 2 on ESTOP_OUT and pin 1 on Net-(D30-K2). LED2 of the dual LED D30 has its anode (A2, pin 4) on ESTOP_OUT. Its cathode (K2, pin 2) returns to ESTOP_OUT through R60, so the LED sits in a loop with no reference node and cannot light.
anomalies.expected: By analogy with the matching LED1 path (D30.1 K1 -> R59 -> R59.2 on GND), R60 pin 2 should return to GND, so that ESTOP_OUT drives the LED anode and the resistor sets the current to ground.

evidence.quote: ESTOP_OUT : D30.4(A2,input) J13.6(Pin_6,passive) J2.6(Pin_6,passive) R60.2(passive) U36.4(Y,output)

anomalies.impact: The E-stop status LED for channel 2 never illuminates, so the status indication is lost. The sink-side logic is otherwise unaffected.

anomalies.observed: The isolated-side ground pins GND2 (pin 5) of both ISO1050 CAN transceivers U10 and U11 are on the main GND net, as are their GND1 pins (pin 4). The isolated side therefore shares ground with the rest of the board.
anomalies.expected: For an isolated CAN transceiver the GND2 pin should be on a separate isolated ground (e.g. GND_ISO) that is not joined to the board ground. The specification describes the CAN buses as isolated.

evidence.quote: GND [High Power] : ... U10.4(GND1,power_in) U10.5(GND2,power_in) U11.4(GND1,power_in) U11.5(GND2,power_in)
two isolated CAN buses (`CAN0`, `CAN1`), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller

anomalies.impact: The galvanic isolation that the CAN interface is meant to provide is defeated, so ground loops and fault paths reach the motor-controller bus directly.

anomalies.observed: The LSM6DS3 auxiliary I2C/SPI master pins SDX (pin 2) and SCX (pin 3) are tied to the GND net, not left unconnected or pulled up.
anomalies.expected: Per common LSM6DS3 practice, the auxiliary master lines SDx/SCx should be left unconnected when unused, not hard-tied to ground.

evidence.quote: GND [High Power] : ... U31.2(SDX,bidirectional) U31.3(SCX,input) U31.6(GND,power_in) U31.7(GND,power_in)

anomalies.impact: An unused auxiliary bus held low could interfere with the IMU's auxiliary interface or its sensor-hub behaviour. The effect is probably minor.

parsed.summary: The most concrete deviation is R60 in the E-stop indicator, whose return pin is on ESTOP_OUT instead of GND, which leaves LED2 in a non-conducting loop. The CAN transceivers' isolated-side ground tied to board GND is a further concern, but it may be a long-standing design choice.
